note: Curated entry points, not a claim of complete review or exhaustive current-trend coverage. Read relevant original sections before applying specific requirements. Review dates are local workflow policy, not evidence expiry.

sources.reviewScope: Browser inspection of title, abstract, status and table of contents. The page identifies the 12 December 2024 Recommendation. Specific success criteria were not individually audited.
sources.use: Read applicable success criteria and conformance requirements for the affected task.
sources.limit: Automated checks alone do not establish full WCAG conformance. Do not substitute project target sizes for exact WCAG level-specific criteria and exceptions.

sources.reviewScope: APG homepage introduction and navigation inspected, including pattern, keyboard and accessible-name guidance entry points. Individual widget patterns not yet reviewed.
sources.use: Consult the actual relevant pattern for custom widget keyboard behavior and semantics; prefer native HTML where suitable.
sources.limit: Example code and guidance are not production certification or a replacement for assistive-technology testing.

sources.reviewScope: Article heading, ten-item index and explanatory text through part of heuristic 8 inspected. Page says last reviewed 30 January 2024. The remaining text and linked studies were not reviewed.
sources.use: Structure an expert inspection of system status, user language, control, consistency, prevention, recognition, efficiency, clarity and recovery.
sources.limit: Broad rules of thumb, not specific experimental evidence for the current BontaFlow audience or guaranteed conversion.

sources.reviewScope: Homepage, stated purpose, component/pattern entry points and update section inspected. Individual components and research reports not yet reviewed.
sources.use: Find task-oriented form and navigation patterns and their documented research context.
sources.limit: Government-service context is not identical to coaching marketing. Do not import its visual identity into BontaFlow.

sources.reviewScope: Overview, current metric definitions, thresholds, lifecycle and initial field-measurement sections inspected; excerpt ended in the JavaScript measurement section.
sources.use: Current page describes LCP <=2.5s, INP <=200ms and CLS <=0.1 at the 75th percentile, segmented mobile/desktop. Recheck before a performance audit.
sources.limit: Lab measurements do not establish passing real-user field metrics or causal commercial impact.

sources.reviewScope: Canonical DESIGN.md read, including continuation after tool truncation; design-system entry, assembly map, logo specification and template guide also read in this session.
sources.use: Re-read affected rules before production; this is a live local authority, not a frozen imported standard.
sources.limit: Historical acceptance and publication records do not prove acceptance or performance of new work.
